title: Freeze executable domain and API contracts
trigger: Authorized actor initiates ValidateContractPackage in SC-01, SC-12; task story: As platform architect, I want to define one versioned object and command vocabulary so every feature shares the same durable state.
observableOutcome: Satisfy the unchanged source acceptance for T-01; primary boundary ValidateContractPackage reaches validated only after actual domain validation. Acknowledged jobs are not completed work.
author: codex
independentReview: Pending real independent review; no review, dependency proof or product execution is asserted.

sourceRequirements.scenario: Given every aggregate in C-01, validating valid and invalid fixtures accepts only correct fields, references and versions; an extension has an explicit version policy.
Given the C-02 command families, OpenAPI examples and event fixtures define request, response, errors, authentication and idempotency; a contract test rejects caller-supplied authority.
Given a schema or API breaking change, compatibility validation fails until migration and consumer examples exist; record exact supported providers/topology and unresolved design decisions.

ownership: Tenant/identity, command, persistence, job, effect, artifact and projection infrastructure; no duplicate domain semantics.
recordMeaning: contract_package is a boundary payload/result view, not permission to create an independent authoritative store. Resolve its fields into the canonical aggregate family in A-05/C-01.

openDecisions.decision: Review this primary boundary against every original scenario; author concrete domain datasets and independent output oracles, not assertions derived from the implementation.
openDecisions.closure: Approved bounded slices with executable negative/recovery fixtures for T-01-AC1, T-01-AC2, T-01-AC3 and a legitimate independent review receipt.

operations.permission: platform.ValidateContractPackage: authenticated scoped membership plus current action grant; viewer may query authorized metadata only. Visible resource denial is 403; hidden or foreign resource is indistinguishable 404. No UI role selector or payload actor grants authority.
operations.exampleMeaning: Reserved synthetic IDs; digest strings are hashes of fixture labels, not claims about real artifacts. Missing referenced records must fail validation.
operations.acknowledgement: Return only computed/readback result; never a static success sample.

permissionRule: platform.ValidateContractPackage: authenticated scoped membership plus current action grant; viewer may query authorized metadata only. Visible resource denial is 403; hidden or foreign resource is indistinguishable 404. No UI role selector or payload actor grants authority.
transactionBoundary: No authoritative domain mutation. Use authorized existing read paths; local preferences are not business facts. Diagnostics emit test artifacts, not product acceptance.
idempotencyRule: Repeat reads without domain writes; cancel older UI request results so they cannot overwrite a newer selection.
invalidationRule: Use CHANGE-PROTOCOL dependency kinds/field paths. Semantic accepted publication atomically advances the authoritative invalidation generation. A view-only change does not invalidate evidence. Projection lag is visible; protected effects revalidate current identity/policy/context/cell epoch.
migrationRecovery: Retain existing URL/selection and readable legacy data. Failed refresh cannot erase last-known data or relabel it fresh. No database migration in this boundary.

persistence.tenantBoundary: Session-derived tenant/workspace; composite references and tenant-leading indices. A payload target tenant is a checked selector only.
persistence.layoutStorage: per-principal view preference; no semantic write

events.meaning: Read/local diagnostics publish no authoritative event.
events.delivery: Outbox at least once; deduplicate eventId, reject obsolete head promotion.

ui.permissionVisibility: Explain disabled visible actions; omit inaccessible resources. Server repeats authorization.
ui.keyboard: Tab reaches all controls in reading order; visible focus, labeled errors, focus first invalid field. Escape closes dialog and restores trigger focus; graph has list/table alternative.
ui.reload: Use durable result ID and pinned baseline, then restore selection/filter. Never replay a mutation just because the page reloads.
ui.legacyException: Implement against existing client/local boundaries. Do not require the unbuilt /api/v1 backend for independent T-01/T-02/T-03 diagnostics.

observability: Record correlation/command/job IDs, operation, authorized scope, version/generation/fence and safe error code. Redact content, credentials and foreign identifiers. Metrics include rejection, conflict, lag and unknown-effect counts; tenant labels are authorized and bounded.
nonGoals: No implementation or independent approval claimed by this draft.
No public deployment, new authority, real transaction or customer-specific policy inferred.
